mapper.select:
SELECT b.pid, b.to_pid, b.from_pid, a.name_, a.sex, a.identify_type, a.identify_number, b.shareholding_ratio, b.rel_category, b.rel_category_sub AS relCategorySub FROM bus_rel_psn a LEFT JOIN bus_rel b ON a.pid = b.from_pid
WHERE b.to_pid = #{pid} AND b.from_type = 'PSN' AND b.to_type = 'SUSORG' AND b.DELFLAG_='1'

select b.pid,b.to_pid,b.from_pid,a.org_name,a.identify_type,a.unisc_code,b.shareholding_ratio,b.rel_category,b.from_memo,b.to_memo from bus_rel_org_suspect a left join bus_rel_suspect b on a.pid=b.from_pid and b.from_type='ORG' and b.to_type='ORG' -- and b.to_pid_shareholders='1' where b.to_pid=#{pid} union select b.pid,b.to_pid,b.from_pid,a.name_,a.identify_type,a.identify_number,b.shareholding_ratio,b.rel_category,b.from_memo,b.to_memo from bus_rel_psn_suspect a left join bus_rel_suspect b on a.pid=b.from_pid -- and b.to_pid_shareholders='1' and b.from_type='PSN' and b.to_type='ORG' left join bus_rel_psn c on c.pid=b.to_pid where b.to_pid=#{pid}

select b.pid,b.to_pid,b.from_pid,a.org_name,a.identify_type,a.unisc_code,b.shareholding_ratio,b.rel_category,b.rel_category_sub as relCategorySub from bus_rel_org a left join bus_rel b on a.pid=b.from_pid and b.to_type='SUSORG' and b.from_type='ORG' where b.to_pid=#{pid}
